body.description: Vacuette: an upright vacuum cleaner creature, bulging dust bag body, a long nozzle hose like an elephant trunk, the floor head as feet, power cord trailing like a tail, one round glowing eye, faded maroon plastic. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
